3e53cf395c820117.job_title: Senior Consultant Dry Bulk & Materials Handling
3e53cf395c820117.description: Deadline to apply is Sunday, 8 November -- Play a leading role in shaping the next generation of dry bulk and industrial projects across the Gulf Region and beyond. As a Senior Consultant Dry Bulk & Materials Handling, you will work with international clients on strategically important projects involving bulk terminals, storage facilities, and industrial plants. You will combine technical expertise with client advisory, supporting projects from early feasibility studies through to implementation. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams and a global network of specialists, you will help clients improve supply chains and address increasingly complex operational, sustainability, and investment challenges. Based in either the United Arab Emirates or Saudi Arabia, you will contribute to projects across the Gulf Region and internationally. What you will do as Senior Consultant Dry Bulk & Materials Handling As a Senior Consultant Dry Bulk & Materials Handling, you will take a leading role in developing and delivering consultancy and engineering projects throughout the Gulf Region. Acting as a trusted advisor to clients, you will translate complex industrial challenges into practical and commercially viable solutions while building long-term client relationships. Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing technical assignments, project delivery, and stakeholder expectations. Contribute throughout all project phases, from feasibility studies and master planning to concept design, basic design, tendering, and implementation. Select, specify, and integrate bulk handling systems and equipment within industrial and port-related facilities. Lead workshops, site surveys, technical reviews, audits, and stakeholder engagement activities to align engineering solutions with client objectives. Prepare and review technical reports, consultancy deliverables, tender documentation, and design specifications. Support procurement processes, including tender evaluations, contractor selection, and contract negotiations. Collaborate with international specialists across disciplines to deliver integrated solutions. Identify and develop new business opportunities and convert market needs into future consulting assignments. Where you will work At Haskoning, you will join an independent, employee-owned international consultancy that combines engineering, design, and consultancy services with software and technology. Our mission, "Enhancing Society Together," drives us to create a positive impact on the world. We offer purpose-driven and challenging work in diverse international projects, leveraging our 140+ years of expertise. With over 6,800 employees in more than 25 countries, we work together to turn challenges into opportunities and make a real impact on society. We collaborate with leading clients in markets such as infrastructure, climate resilience, renewable energy, decarbonisation of industry, and sustainable mobility. You will join the Industry & Buildings business line in our Dubai office, where you will work closely with colleagues from Industry & Buildings and Water & Maritime. Together, you will deliver complex industrial and terminal projects for clients in sectors including minerals, agribulk, critical raw materials, chemicals, metals, and ports. As one of the senior members of the team, you will have the opportunity to influence project direction, support the growth of our regional activities, and help develop the next generation of engineering talent. What you bring You are an experienced engineering professional with strong expertise in dry bulk and materials handling. You are comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders on strategic investment decisions while also contributing to technical studies, designs, and consultancy deliverables. You combine analytical thinking with a proactive mindset and enjoy taking ownership of your work in an international environment. Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 7-15 years of experience in dry bulk handling, materials handling, terminal engineering, mining, ports, or heavy industry. Proven experience working on projects within the Gulf Region. Strong knowledge of dry bulk handling systems, storage facilities, and associated infrastructure. Experience with feasibility studies, master planning, concept development, tender design, and owner's engineering assignments. Solid understanding of CAPEX, project execution strategies, and investment decision-making processes. Strong stakeholder management and client-facing skills. Experience working with international and multicultural project teams. Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership capabilities. Commercially aware and entrepreneurial, with the ability to develop client relationships and generate new business opportunities. Willingness to be based in the United Arab Emirates or Saudi Arabia and travel when required for projects. What you can expect from us At Haskoning, we believe that the well-being of our employees is essential to our shared success. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both your professional development and personal well-being. What We Offer A solid foundation: A competitive base salary with annual increases. Prioritisation of your well-being: By offering flexibility, support and a strong sense of community to ensure work and personal life go hand in hand. Development opportunities: A wide range of training and development programs, including tailored learning paths, learning weeks, and various knowledge-sharing groups. Informal and inclusive culture: A welcoming and open environment where people come first, diversity is embraced, team spirit is high, and everyone is approachable. And with voluntary social and sports activities, and employee networks such as Pride and Young Haskoning. Regional impact: The opportunity to strengthen and grow Haskoning’s dry bulk and materials handling business across the Gulf Region, with the autonomy of a regional role and the backing of an international consultancy and engineering firm. Diverse project exposure: The opportunity to contribute to dry bulk and industrial projects throughout the Gulf Region. Responsibility and autonomy: Significant ownership in project delivery, client engagement and business development. Are you our new colleague? Then we would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter before Sunday, 8 November . After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. Do you have any questions about the role or the process? You can always contact Maria Boeve, Recruiter Industry & Energy, at [Click to show email] . At Haskoning, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. Our mission of "Enhancing Society Together" drives us to create an environment that embraces each individual’s unique background, identity, and perspective. Regardless of your experience, background, age, gender, or other personal characteristics—you are welcome here. We believe that diversity makes us stronger and that an inclusive culture gives everyone the opportunity to grow and contribute. Read more about our ED&I initiatives on our dedicated webpage . Due to the privacy law, please submit your application via the apply button and not via email. Acquisition for this vacancy by agencies is not appreciated and offered candidates will not be taken into consideration.

3ec1a28a56d4b4de.description: Set up and operate CNC turn/mill machines, including 3-axis and 5-axis CNC machines, according to approved drawings and work instructions. Operate different CNC machines from manufacturers such as Doosan, Okuma, and Mazak. Demonstrate working knowledge of Fanuc, Okuma, and Mazatrol CNC controls. Read and interpret engineering drawings, machining instructions, tooling information, and dimensional requirements. Load and unload workpieces safely and correctly using appropriate lifting and handling equipment. Select and install appropriate cutting tools, holders, jaws, fixtures, and work holding equipment. Set tool offsets, work offsets, tool wear compensation, and other required machine parameters. Verify CNC programs and ensure correct program selection before starting machining operations. Perform first-piece inspection and make necessary dimensional adjustments within approved parameters. Monitor machine operation, cutting conditions, tool wear, coolant levels, and machining cycle to ensure stable production. Identify and report abnormal machine conditions, tool failures, dimensional deviations, and other production issues to the Production Team Leader. Use appropriate measuring instruments such as vernier calipers, micrometers, bore gauges, thread gauges, and other inspection equipment. Perform routine cleaning and basic operator-level maintenance of CNC machines and work areas. Ensure proper handling and storage of cutting tools, fixtures, measuring instruments, and other production equipment. Follow all approved production procedures, quality requirements, and safety instructions. Ensure proper use of PPE and maintain good housekeeping in the CNC work area. Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving productivity, cycle time, machine utilization, and overall equipment efficiency. Contribute to achieving daily production targets while maintaining required quality standards. Perform other production-related duties assigned by the Production Team Leader. Understand and comply with all applicable QMS & EHSMS requirements and policies. Perform work to protect the environment and maintain a safe and healthy workplace with zero harm goals. Stay aware of departmental risks and opportunities and handle them for continuous improvement. Desired Candidate Profile Knowledge of 3-axis and 5-axis CNC turn/mill machine operation, threading standards (API), tool changes, and minor adjustments. Ability to read technical drawings, NC Codes understanding and measure parts for quality control. Good understanding of machining processes, tooling, cutting speeds, feeds, and tool wear. Attention to detail to ensure high-quality machining and threading through precise setup and operation. Capable of troubleshooting minor machine malfunctions and making adjustments to optimize performance. Ability to manage machine operations and production timelines effectively. Strong ability to collaborate with team members, including CNC Programmers and quality control staff.

3e716eec7689574c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن مدير مراجعة داخلية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية للمراجعة الداخلية، وضمان التزام الموظفين بالأنظمة واللوائح، والتحقق من كفاءة الإجراءات لحماية أصول الجهة وممتلكاتها. كما يقدم شاغل الوظيفة المشورة للإدارة في المواضيع المتعلقة بعمل المراجعة الداخلية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة عمليات فحص التقارير والمستندات والسجلات المالية والحسابات الختامية والعقود والاتفاقيات المبرمة، للتأكد من صحتها ونظاميتها. تحديد مواطن الخلل وسوء الاستخدام المحتملة ضمن العمليات والإجراءات. ضمان فعالية ودقة أنشطة تنظيم وحفظ الوثائق الخاصة بعمليات المراجعة الداخلية، بما يضمن سهولة استرجاعها والاستفادة منها عند الحاجة. إعداد خطط التدقيق التي تهدف إلى التأكد من التزام موظفي الجهة بالأنظمة واللوائح والتعليمات والإجراءات المعمول بها. التحقق من كفاءة وملاءمة الأنظمة والإجراءات لضمان حماية أصول الجهة وممتلكاتها من الاختلاس أو الضياع أو التلاعب. تقديم المشورة المتخصصة للإدارة العليا في جميع المواضيع ذات العلاقة بعمل المراجعة الداخلية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المراجعة الداخلية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تطوير أهداف المراجعة الداخلية وإعداد خطط التدقيق. فهم عميق للأنظمة واللوائح والتعليمات والإجراءات المتعلقة بالعمليات المالية والإدارية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض. يتطلب العمل الالتزام الكامل بمهام المراجعة الداخلية لضمان أعلى مستويات النزاهة والفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة معين للموارد البشرية.

Responsibilities encompass the sign-off of all red X and circle red X conditions related to aircraft systems and components. Engages in technical inspection of specific airframe, powertrain, power-plant, armament, electrical, and avionics systems. Evaluates the need for Maintenance Test Flights (MTF) and Maintenance Operational Checks (MOC), providing inspection criteria interpretation to the maintenance staff. Utilizes common measuring tools, precision measuring gauges, and alignment fixtures (GFE). Assists the Customer in maintaining a current technical library and relevant aircraft forms and records. Collaborates with the Customer Weight and Balance (W&B) technician to complete Weight and Balance records for all assigned aircraft, adhering to Customer directives and applicable manuals. Role Description / Responsibilities Responsible for complete QA/QC inspection and documentation for all MEP works including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, drainage, fire alarm, firefighting and associated ELV interfaces. Prepare, maintain and close all MEP QA/QC documentation in accordance with project specifications, approved drawings, consultant requirements and applicable codes. Prepare and submit Work Inspection Requests (WIRs/IRs) and coordinate inspections with the consultant/client. Prepare and maintain Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) for all MEP activities. Prepare Method Statements , inspection checklists and QA/QC forms for MEP activities. Maintain complete QA/QC registers and trackers including WIR, MIR, NCR, RFI, material approval and testing/commissioning logs. Conduct daily site inspections to ensure MEP installation complies with approved shop drawings, specifications, approved materials and method statements . Identify defective/non-compliant work and issue or coordinate NCRs, observations and corrective-action reports . Follow up NCRs and consultant comments until 100% closure . Coordinate with MEP engineers, supervisors and subcontractors to rectify quality issues before consultant inspection. Verify that only approved materials are delivered and installed on site and check material certificates, datasheets, test certificates and approvals. Inspect HVAC works including ductwork, insulation, chilled water/refrigerant piping, FCUs/AHUs, diffusers, dampers and equipment installation . Inspect electrical works including containment, conduits, cable trays, wiring, DBs, panels, lighting, power, earthing and associated systems . Inspect plumbing and drainage works including water supply, drainage piping, pressure testing, slopes, supports, insulation and fixtures . Inspect firefighting and fire alarm installations and coordinate required inspections and testing. Ensure proper MEP coordination above ceilings and within walls before closing ceilings, partitions or access panels , particularly important on high-end fit-out projects. Verify MEP interfaces with architectural finishes, joinery, ceilings, lighting, specialist systems and FF&E to prevent damage and rework. Witness and document pressure tests, insulation resistance tests, continuity tests, duct leakage tests, flushing, testing & balancing and other required MEP tests . Coordinate and maintain complete Testing & Commissioning (T&C) documentation , test sheets and certificates. Monitor calibration certificates for testing instruments and ensure only calibrated equipment is used. Carry out pre-inspections before raising inspections to the consultant to minimize rejection rates. Monitor workmanship quality and ensure installations meet the required high-end fit-out finish standards . Prepare snag/punch lists , coordinate rectification and obtain consultant/client closure. Review and verify MEP as-built drawings against actual site installations. Compile MEP sections of the O&M manuals, warranties, certificates, testing reports and handover documentation . Prepare and maintain the complete MEP QA/QC dossier / handover file for final project closeout. Attend QA/QC, MEP coordination and consultant meetings as required. Provide daily/weekly quality reports and highlight outstanding inspections, NCRs, approvals and quality risks to the Project Manager/QAQC Manager. Maintain properly organized electronic and hard-copy records so that every installed MEP activity is traceable from material approval through inspection, testing and final handover .

3e42f162b96802a3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المحيط عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تطوير وتحسين جودة خدمة العملاء، وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء، والمشاركة في وضع الإجراءات والأدلة لضمان رضا العملاء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة ويعتبر وظيفة بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة لوضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الجودة في خدمة العملاء، بالتنسيق مع إدارة الجودة، وضمان المتابعة المستمرة. المشاركة في وضع وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما في ذلك تفاصيل الاتصال بهم واستلام طلباتهم واستفساراتهم والرد عليها بفعالية وكفاءة، والتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية. تطوير برامج متقدمة ومبادرات إبداعية لضمان تجاوز توقعات واحتياجات العملاء من حيث جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، بهدف بناء نموذج متكامل لخدمة العملاء. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتحليل نتائج تقييم رضا العملاء، وتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات، ووضع الخطط لمعالجتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على وضع وتحديد مؤشرات ومعايير الأداء والجودة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف وتحليل بيانات رضا العملاء. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة، شفهية وكتابية. القدرة على إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرار. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتنسيق مع الإدارات المختلفة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق خدمة العملاء في شركة المحيط. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

3e435db27b145304.description: About the Role Danaher, through its operating company Masimo, is seeking a Quality Control Inspector to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time, on-site position is responsible for ensuring product quality at various stages of the manufacturing process, from incoming materials to in-process and outgoing products. The role involves verifying that all materials and products meet or exceed the standards outlined in company documentation and procedures. Company Overview Masimo, an operating company of Danaher, is a global medical technology company specializing in industry-leading monitoring technologies. Their product portfolio includes non-invasive measurements, sensors, patient monitors, and automation and connectivity solutions. Masimo's mission focuses on empowering clinicians to enhance patient care through innovation. The company operates within Danaher's system of continuous improvement, aiming for tangible impact in life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology. Responsibilities Perform receiving, in-process, and final inspections of products according to acceptance procedure (AP) documents. Generate and complete Quality Reports in compliance with released acceptance procedures, drawings, bill of materials, assembly master records, and device master records. Conduct functional testing as per acceptance procedures (AP) and drawing (DR) requirements. Release and approve product labels. Review work and job orders for adherence to internal documentation, including assembly master records (AMR), device master records (DMR), drawings (DR), and bill of materials (MB). Identify, segregate, and generate Non-Conforming Report (NCR) for nonconforming products and materials. Stay updated with document revision changes that impact inspection processes. Move materials to designated locations to support inspections, Material Review Board (MRB), Return Material Authorization (RMA), and inventory processes. This includes physical movement of material in the warehouse and/or QC Areas, use of pallet jacks, packing and unpacking, palletizing, lifting, and verification of material quantities and documents. Qualifications and Requirements 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Ability to understand and apply acceptance procedures, drawings, and other technical documentation. Proficiency in generating and completing quality reports. Capability to perform physical material handling tasks, including lifting and operating pallet jacks. Work Environment This position is located in Riyadh and reports to the Senior Manager, Quality, as part of the Quality Control team. It is an on-site role, with potential eligibility for a remote work arrangement where work can be performed from home. Further details regarding remote work eligibility will be provided during the interview process. Application Information Masimo, a Danaher operating company, offers competitive benefit programs. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join a team focused on innovation and impact in patient care.

3ec391e7782fd767.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة تقنيات المختبرات التجارية عن كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على إجراء الأبحاث والتحاليل الكيميائية للعناصر والمركبات بهدف تطوير المنتجات والعمليات والتطبيقات. يتضمن العمل إجراء تحاليل كمية ونوعية، وتحسين الطرق التحليلية، وتنفيذ التجارب المخبرية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الأبحاث والتجارب والتحاليل الكمية والنوعية للعناصر والمركبات العضوية واللاعضوية لتحديد خواصها الكيميائية وبنيتها وتفاعلاتها، ودراسة وتحليل النتائج. تصميم وسائل وأساليب وتجهيزات، وتطوير المعادلات والعمليات والطرق لحل المشكلات الفنية العملية. إجراء الأبحاث على المنتجات الكيميائية المصنعة لتطوير وتحسين الإجراءات والعمليات وجودة المنتجات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بنتائج الدراسات الفيزيائية وسبل تطويرها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الكيمياء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إجراء الأبحاث والتحاليل الكيميائية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل الكيميائي ضمن فريق متخصص في مؤسسة تقنيات المختبرات التجارية، مع التركيز على الابتكار والتطوير في مجال التحاليل الكيميائية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

3e20ea2b41e979dd.description: About Galderma Galderma is a dermatology company operating in approximately 90 countries. The company focuses on an innovative, science-based portfolio of brands and services across Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare, and Therapeutic Dermatology. Established in 1981, Galderma aims to meet consumer and patient needs in skin health through partnerships with healthcare professionals. The Role: Medical Representative, Dermatological Skincare Pharmacies Galderma is seeking a Medical Representative for Dermatological Skincare Pharmacies in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and involves executing field visits, building relationships with healthcare professionals, and promoting Galderma's dermatological skincare portfolio within pharmacies. The role focuses on driving product recommendation, business growth, and customer loyalty. Key Responsibilities Execute planned field visits to pharmacies, pharmacists, and designated healthcare professionals according to territory coverage plans and segmentation targets. Build and maintain long-term relationships with pharmacists, pharmacy chains, and key retail stakeholders to drive product recommendation, business growth, and customer loyalty. Strengthen engagement and loyalty toward Galderma brands through consistent scientific promotion, professional customer service, and effective relationship management. Ensure excellent visibility and positioning of Galderma products across assigned pharmacy accounts, maintaining the company's image as a leader in dermatology and skincare. Organize and support pharmacy-focused meetings, activation programs, and promotional events in alignment with business objectives. Prepare and submit accurate business reports, including daily activities, weekly plans, monthly updates, and territory performance analyses. Monitor competitor activities, pricing strategies, new launches, and market dynamics to identify opportunities and potential business risks. Handle pharmacy and customer complaints professionally by investigating issues, proposing solutions, and escalating where necessary. Collect and report pharmacovigilance cases in full compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. Ensure full compliance with company legal, ethical, and compliance standards, as well as local laws and regulations, in all interactions and activities. Maintain up-to-date product, market, and category knowledge to ensure high-quality customer engagement and effective communication of scientific and commercial messages. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in science or pharmacy, or equivalent experience/qualification. At least 2-3 years of working experience in sales, preferably within the beauty, dermatology, or skincare industry. Solid sales experience with a track record of developing and engaging customers and delivering on company targets. Must be analytical, detail-oriented, organized, and systematic. Experience in territory and distributor management is an advantage. Working at Galderma Galderma focuses on advancing dermatology through science-led innovation and customer partnership. Employees are encouraged to focus on results, embrace learning, and bring positive energy, combining initiative with teamwork. The company aims to empower employees and promote personal growth while respecting diversity and individual rights. Application This role offers an opportunity to contribute to a high-performing team and play a key role in building long-term success in Saudi Arabia.

3e9de8ab3d43aa96.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة مفخرة الشرق للتشغيل والصيانة عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على جميع جوانب عمليات الصيانة، بما في ذلك التخطيط، وتوزيع المهام، وتقييم الأداء، وتطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الخاص بالصيانة. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة. تقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة لعمليات الصيانة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على فريق الصيانة بناءً على الإمكانات والقدرات الفردية. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم. تصميم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفريق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج وتقارير العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الصيانة أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على إعداد خطط وبرامج العمل. مهارات جيدة في توزيع المهام وإدارة الفريق. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وتخطيطية ممتازة. القدرة على تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية وتطوير المهارات. مهارات التواصل الفعال والعمل الجماعي. الدقة في تصنيف وتوثيق التقارير. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الصيانة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة مفخرة الشرق للتشغيل والصيانة في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع فريق الصيانة والإدارة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

3e5619966fad8c54.description: We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented, and ambitious Database Administrator Trainee to join our Data Platform team through the Tamheer Program. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, analyzing system behavior, working with data, and understanding how critical technology platforms operate behind the scenes. As a DBA Trainee, you will gain hands-on exposure to production-scale database environments and learn how databases are designed, monitored, optimized, secured, backed up, and recovered. Database administration requires precision and responsibility. A small configuration or query mistake can sometimes have a significant impact. Therefore, we are looking for someone who approaches tasks carefully, validates their work, asks the right questions, and remains calm when investigating technical problems. This will be a challenging learning journey filled with technical exploration, troubleshooting, benchmarking, automation, and real-world engineering experience. Key Responsibilities You will work closely with experienced Database Administrators, Data Engineers, and Platform Engineers to: Write, review, and optimize SQL queries. The ability to write queries using joins, aggregations, filtering, and subqueries. Basic Python programming skills. Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities. An analytical mindset and close attention to detail. The ability to compare results, benchmark solutions, and validate assumptions. A willingness to investigate problems instead of accepting results at face value. Good communication and documentation skills. A strong desire to learn database technologies and production engineering practices. Preferred Knowledge The following experience is beneficial but not mandatory: Familiarity with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, or similar database technologies. Basic knowledge of Linux and command-line tools. Understanding of database indexes, transactions, schemas, and data types. Exposure to Git, APIs, cloud platforms, or container technologies. Experience working on academic, personal, or graduation projects involving data or automation. What You Will Learn During the program, you will have the opportunity to learn: How enterprise databases operate at scale. Database performance tuning and query optimization. You will enjoy this role if you: Are curious about how systems work internally. Enjoy investigating difficult technical problems. Pay attention to small details that others may overlook. Are comfortable asking questions and learning from feedback. Take ownership of your work and verify your results. See challenges as opportunities to learn and improve. Want to build a career in databases, cloud data platforms, or reliability engineering. Our Commitment to You You will not be expected to know everything from day one. You will receive guidance, practical experience, and opportunities to work with experienced engineers. At the same time, we will challenge you to think critically, research independently, test your ideas, and gradually take ownership of meaningful technical tasks. This is more than a training opportunity. It is an adventure into the world of databases, where reliability, accuracy, automation, and engineering discipline come together to support systems used at scale.
